decisions.reason: The award-winning high-pressure geothermal probe performs above aspiration in a growing geothermal market, so there is no trigger for problemistic search and every reason to keep it.
The single-U borehole probe is a standard building block of the established geothermal range, and the firm's slack lets it carry the product while the heat-pump-driven market grows.
The surface technology complements the geothermal probe line at low incremental cost, and no shortfall is evident that would justify withdrawing it.
Fire-protection steel profile systems are close to the core building-systems business and meet steady, regulation-driven demand, so results likely meet aspirations.
The slim steel profile system fits the firm's core window and facade offer and is supported by growing industry turnover, leaving no performance gap to act on.
The decorative surface system is a niche add-on with uncertain results, but the large firm's slack and its low cost within the profile range support keeping it.
